messages:
emily: Stripe alerted on MER-9903 for geo-velocity chargebacks — 3 disputes from different countries in a 12h window. They put a provisional payout hold. Need quick evidence packet and decision on internal hold. Payment ids: pay_6ZxH1, pay_6ZxH2, pay_6ZxH3.

payments-bot: stripe.event: payout.hold.created reason="geo_velocity" merchant=MER-9903

paul: Can we see BIN/IP overlap and whether refunds were issued by support? Also any recurring merchant flags?

emily: No support refunds yet. BIN is 400005 on all three txns. IPs are from 81.2.45.x and 200.43.12.x (different geos). Invoice refs: INV-2026-9430, INV-2026-9431, INV-2026-9432. Quick export:
```csv
payment_id,amount,currency,created_at,invoice,card_last4,bin,ip,country,chargeback
pay_6ZxH1,79.00,USD,2026-06-03T01:15:00Z,INV-2026-9430,1234,400005,81.2.45.22,GB,true
pay_6ZxH2,79.00,USD,2026-06-03T05:30:10Z,INV-2026-9431,1234,400005,200.43.12.8,BR,true
pay_6ZxH3,79.00,USD,2026-06-03T08:05:55Z,INV-2026-9432,1234,400005,203.0.113.50,AU,true
```

natalie: I'll gather AVS/CVV, device fingerprints, shipping/fulfillment proofs, and merchant KYC. ETA ~90m. Will prepare a single PDF for Stripe with server logs and order receipts.

paul: Recommend we apply internal payout hold immediately to avoid further exposure. I'll set it unless legal objects.

emily: Go ahead, apply hold and tag fraud-ops and legal. Also draft the merchant notice: neutral tone, request order/tracking and KYC within 72h.

payments-bot: internal.case: created CASE-2026-11100 by emily

paul: Internal hold applied for MER-9903 (actioned). Monitoring for new disputes.

natalie: Uploaded initial evidence bundle to Stripe dispute portal (csv + logs + merchant receipts). If Stripe asks for additional proofs we'll add device fingerprints.

emily: Thanks all. Keep this thread updated if we get merchant replies or Stripe asks for more. Closing for now but leave open for follow-ups. :lock:
